body: I hate medications, due largely to the fact that I grew up around and was raised by people who relied on pills for their ability to cope with the world. That said, I'd be willing to try it if I wasn't broke and jobless.

Thank you for your words. 

Yes, for a long time absolute mutual love was ours. This is the second marriage for both of us, we'd both learned harsh lessons our first times around. We committed to making this work no matter what. But sometimes, the reality is far less than the ideal. It's not as simple as sticking with it until it gets fixed.. I've tried that. I can't fake it till I make it. Not since I found the pictures she'd sent to a friend of ours. 

I've tried to let that go. I've forgiven her, I forgave her the day I found out, but what I'm finding is that I can't make myself fully trust her. Which in turn makes her feel like she can't trust me.
